description: This file contains CLI commands and utilities for managing Flask applications, including running a development server, opening a shell, and displaying routes. It also includes functions for locating and loading Flask apps, handling environment variables, and custom click command groups.

classes.name: CertParamType
classes.description: Custom click parameter type for SSL certificate options, allowing file paths, 'adhoc', or SSLContext objects.

classes.name: ScriptInfo
classes.description: Helper class for managing Flask application loading, environment setup, and context management within CLI commands.

classes.name: FlaskGroup
classes.description: Custom click group supporting dynamic loading of Flask app commands and context management.

methods.name: find_best_app
methods.description: Finds the best Flask application instance in a module by common attribute names or factory functions.

methods.name: _called_with_wrong_args
methods.description: Checks if calling a function raised a TypeError due to wrong arguments.

methods.name: find_app_by_string
methods.description: Locates a Flask app in a module based on a string expression, which can be a variable or function call.

methods.name: prepare_import
methods.description: Converts a file path to a Python module import path.

methods.name: locate_app
methods.description: Imports a module and finds a Flask application instance based on name or factory.

methods.name: get_version
methods.description: Outputs the current Python, Flask, and Werkzeug versions.

methods.name: load_dotenv
methods.description: Loads environment variables from dotenv files, with precedence rules.

methods.name: show_server_banner
methods.description: Displays startup messages for the Flask server, unless reloading.

methods.name: with_appcontext
methods.description: Decorator to ensure a CLI callback runs within the Flask application context.

methods.name: _set_app
methods.description: Callback to set the Flask app import path from CLI options.

methods.name: _set_debug
methods.description: Callback to set the Flask debug mode environment variable.

methods.name: _env_file_callback
methods.description: Loads environment variables from dotenv files when specified.

methods.name: load_dotenv
methods.description: Function to load dotenv environment variables from files.
